purpose: Prove that decision contexts remain time-aware, evidence-bound, audience-aware, and candidate-only before any query-generation or graph-migration work.
proven_cases: Current status plus reviewed support and counterevidence is candidate-ready, never an approved recommendation.
Support-only evidence remains candidate-only and exposes the counterevidence gap.
Missing or expired required status is STALE_OR_UNKNOWN.
Conflicting required status and unreviewed strategic evidence require HITL.
The projection exposes the source assertion IDs behind included observations and evidence.

active_graph.posture: No decision context is written to the active graph. W12 approval-bound migration remains the only path to target-graph mutation.

next_gate: W15 query/use-case evaluation over candidate-only decision contexts
